items.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023
items.q: And so Dick Berk was with us and then after a while Dick left and we got Al Foster came in on drums.

ctx.x: Yeah. On that job he played electric bass, left handed electric bass. And so Dick Berk was with us and then after a while Dick left and we got Al Foster came in on drums. This group was dynamite. It was too strong for that club, and I’ll tell you what I mean. It was the first exposure to music that anybody walking in the club was exposed to this group. This group was so powerful that they did not want to go to any of the other rooms. They had showrooms, they had a dinner room, they had two rooms upstairs that had…
wanted to stop playing. It was just, it was the epitome of having a good time playing music. It was just a monster.
